name: Iguaçu Falls
blurb: Conversation about Iguaçu Falls is up 197% on its six-month baseline, driven by travellers describing it as a calmer alternative to nearby hotspots. Most posts mention beaches, value and the shoulder season.

positive: Food repeatedly singled out as a highlight
negative: Some report crowding at peak times
Prices noticeably up on last season

quotes.text: Second time here and it still feels underrated.
The food alone would be worth the trip.
Getting harder to find a decent room under budget this year.
